statement: On each required physical-device class, JustTones shall complete two hours of continuous playback without a crash or forced termination, JustTones-attributable dropout, excessive pitch drift, amplitude accumulation or decay, playback-state inconsistency, or persisted-data corruption. iPhone testing shall include locked-screen playback; Watch testing shall include display-dimmed and wrist-down operation where permitted.
title: Playback Endurance
